b3020c984f15c1d5.description: **Department**: Technology **Location**: Surat, Gujarat (on-site) **Employment Type**: Full-time, Permanent **Experience Required:** 2–4 years **About UniSouk** UniSouk is a fast-growing e-commerce technology company building India’s next-generation unified seller platform, integrating major marketplaces, payment gateways, logistics systems and analytics tools into a single dashboard. We build scalable SaaS products that simplify digital commerce for small and medium businesses across India. **Role Overview** We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our core technology team and take ownership of features end to end — from database and API through to the interfaces our sellers use every day. This is a build role at a product company, not a services or maintenance role. You will work directly on the platform, ship features that go live to real sellers, and see the impact of your work in production quickly. The team is small, so the scope is wide and the ownership is real. We are specifically looking for someone who wants to build here over several years rather than treat this as a stepping stone. As the platform scales, the people who joined early and understood it deeply will lead the teams that come after them. Key Responsibilities Backend Development ●Design, build and maintain backend services, APIs and business logic for the UniSouk platform ● Build and maintain integrations with marketplaces, payment gateways, logistics providers and analytics tools ● Design database schemas, write efficient queries and manage data models as the platform grows ● Handle authentication, authorisation and role-based access across the application ● Write services that handle scale reliably — queues, scheduled jobs, rate limits and third-party API failures **Frontend Development** ● Build responsive, performant interfaces for the seller dashboard ● Translate designs and product requirements into clean, maintainable components ● Manage application state, data fetching and error handling on the client ● Ensure consistent behaviour across browsers and screen sizes **Platform & Deployment** ● Deploy and maintain applications on AWS and CloudFlare. ● Work with CI/CD pipelines using Git, GitHub and GitHub Actions ● Monitor application health, investigate production issues and resolve them promptly ● Contribute to performance optimisation, logging and observability **Code Quality & Collaboration** ● Write clean, documented, testable code and participate in code reviews ● Maintain technical documentation for the systems you build ● Work with the product and operations teams to translate requirements into technical solutions ● Track your work on Zoho Projects, keeping task status and timelines current. Support and guide junior developers and interns as the team grows **Requirements** ● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field ● 2–4 years of hands-on full stack development experience ● Strong proficiency in [Node.js /Nest.js] for backend development ● Strong proficiency in [React.js / Next.js] for frontend development ● Solid working knowledge of [PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB] including schema design and query optimisation ● Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and integrating third-party services ● Working knowledge of Git and collaborative development workflows ● Familiarity with AWS deployment and cloud infrastructure basics ● Strong problem-solving ability and willingness to debug unfamiliar systems ● Able to work on-site in Surat full-time **Good to Have** ● Experience building or integrating with e-commerce marketplace APIs (Amazon SP-API, Flipkart, Shopify) ● Experience with payment gateway or logistics API integrations ● Exposure to TypeScript, Docker, Redis or message queues ● Experience in a product or SaaS company rather than services only ● Prior startup experience, with comfort in a fast-moving, broad-scope environment ● Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into web applications **Who This Role Suits** This role will suit you if you want depth rather than variety — to know one product thoroughly, own significant parts of it, and grow with it as it scales. It will suit you less if you prefer narrowly defined tickets or want to switch roles every twelve months. Expect release periods to be demanding, with occasional availability needed outside normal hours when something breaks in production. In return, you get genuine ownership, direct access to the founders, and a say in technical decisions from early on. **Outstation Candidates** We welcome applications from candidates outside Surat and outside Gujarat. Please note that this is a fully on-site role in Surat. -Candidates applying from outside the city should be prepared to relocate independently and join on-site from day one. We would rather be clear about this upfront than have it come up late in the process. **What We Offer** ● Direct ownership of product features that reach real users ● A small, senior team with no layers between you and the decision-makers ● Clear growth into senior and lead roles as the engineering team expands

Who We Are 
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. 
 
Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!
Your Team and Role 
Working on the Marketing and Communications Functional Team, you'll help shape how millions of people hear about DuckDuckGo, lead projects, and own key ongoing work.
 
As a Social Media And Communications Manager, you'll write social media copy, manage social media mentions and communities, coordinate proactive announcements, manage incoming press requests, regularly report out and keep track of key performance metrics and work on related projects. You'll be the directly responsible individual (DRI) on your own projects from scoping through postmortem, collaborating closely with product, design, legal, support, and leadership. 
 
Example projects include: 
• 
Announcing DuckDuckGo products and features, across press, social, and community channels.
• 
Running a multi-week social campaign to raise awareness of a product area, from measuring the baseline and planning content through weekly reporting and recommendations.
About You
• 
6+ years in communications, including PR and social media, ideally in tech.
• 
Excellent writing skills, with the ability to explain products clearly, without jargon.
• 
Hands-on social media experience, including content development and community management on X, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and Bluesky.
• 
Media relations experience, including pitching journalists, handling inquiries, and building press relationships.
• 
Experience measuring social media and earned media reach, engagement, sentiment, and campaign impact and turning results into insightful reports.
• 
Fluency in online culture, with strong judgment about when to join a conversation and when not to.
• 
Ability to run multiple campaigns, content calendars, and approval cycles with cross-functional team members at once.
• 
Proven ability to manage projects from kickoff through delivery.
Compensation
This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:
 
• 
United States: $129,000 USD annually
• 
United Kingdom: £97,300 GBP annually
• 
Canada: C$183,200 CAD annually
• 
Europe/Rest of World: €113,750 EUR annually
 
In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.
 
Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.
 
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.
 
Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.
 
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.
 
We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

Headquarters: Remote - Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.
Why You’ll Love This Role

The Cloud Partner Sales Manager builds and executes joint go-to-market plans with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role grows partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue by connecting Cribl’s sales teams with CSP field, executive, and technical organizations and advancing co-sell, marketplace, and customer adoption opportunities.

You will act as the key connector between internal enterprise sales teams and external CSP ecosystems. By cultivating executive, field sales, and technical relationships, you will align key cloud sales plays, oversee joint account mapping, and lead co-selling initiatives to drive top-line pipeline growth and customer adoption.

This is a remote role with a preference for candidates located in the Northeast.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

• Alliance strategy and governance: Develop multi-year partner plans with shared goals, milestones, and KPIs. Track performance against Strategic Collaboration Agreements (SCAs), including revenue, cloud consumption, co-investment, and program benefits; identify risks and course corrections.

• Co-selling and pipeline: Own regional partner-driven and partner-influenced targets. Lead joint account mapping, deal registration, pipeline reviews, and forecasting with Cribl and CSP sales teams. Align CSP sales plays with Cribl solutions to improve win rates and deal velocity.

• Marketplace and consumption: Use AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces to simplify procurement and support customer cloud commitments. Partner with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to accelerate onboarding, adoption, and consumption.

• Enablement and demand generation: Equip Cribl and CSP field teams to position Cribl’s value and solutions. Partner with Marketing on co-marketing, demand generation, and field events.

• Executive alignment and reviews: Build relationships with CSP executives, sales leaders, and technical architects. Lead regular business reviews and executive briefings, sharing scorecards, pipeline insights, progress against commitments, and actions to strengthen the partnership.

• We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

If You’ve Got It - We Want It 

• 5–10+ years in enterprise software sales, business development, or strategic alliances in SaaS or the ISV ecosystem.

• Track record of achieving or exceeding partner-sourced or co-sell revenue targets with major cloud providers.

• Strong understanding of cloud ecosystems, marketplaces, co-sell programs (such as AWS ACE, Microsoft Partner Center, or GCP Partner Advantage), and consumption-based business models.

• Ability to build executive relationships and influence matrixed sales organizations.

• Strong strategic, analytical, communication, and presentation skills; able to manage complex joint pipelines and translate technical solutions into business value.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

#LI-Remote

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

$130,000—$150,000 USD

b3d959442eabdc54.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Software Engineer, Guest & host


Airbnb was born in 2007 when two Hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 6 million Hosts who have welcomed more than 1 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, Hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Cities Team at Airbnb is chartered with driving sustainable global growth by developing the necessary software systems to enable Airbnb to work effectively with local governments. This involves designing systems that allow us to flexibly model the breadth of regulations around the world, deploy them safely and operationalize thousands around the world. At the same time, we are stewards of our global business and build systems to maximize growth and retention of global supply. Advocating for fair regulations is key, as it establishes a clear framework for Airbnb's continued growth and ensures continuous business expansion.

This is a highly collaborative team that works in close partnership with Operations, Product, Policy and legal functions around the company. In addition, you will be part of a global team with members in the US and India.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will be responsible for building the tools and systems to scale regulatory launches worldwide with a focus on supply growth and retention. You will design and build product and platform features to achieve our goals. You will help define and maintain a culture of craftsmanship and excellence. You will represent the engineering team with global cross-functional partners across a variety of regulatory projects.

A Typical Day:

  • Work closely with global cross-functional stakeholders for product alignment, requirements and shaping specifications
  • Build our features and platforms for high-scale and reliability and employing engineering best practices
  • Foster a culture of craftsmanship that emphasizes both the successful delivery of business initiatives and a commitment to quality
  • Strategising and brainstorming opportunities along with Product, Partnerships & other cross-functional leaders and driving effective relevant metrics to measure the success of these initiatives.
  • Support 24x7 engineering ops to maintain high reliability services

 Your expertise:

  • BS, MS or Ph.D. in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 2+​ years of relevant engineering work experience
  • Strong coding abilities and experience with architectural patterns of large, high-scale applications.
  • Proficiency in one or more JVM based languages (Java, Kotlin, Scala, etc.) are preferred
  • Familiar with frontend web technologies  (e.g. HTML, CSS, React and Graphql etc)
  • Experience architecting, building, and maintaining highly available services in a service-oriented architecture (SOA).
  • Familiarity with patterns, libraries and frameworks for building and testing services, and service-to-service communication.
  • Successfully partnering with Operations, Policy, Legal, and Product functions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to structure complex, ambiguous problems, identify patterns, and propose data-driven solutions. Self-driven with strong project management abilities.
  • Ability to drive end-to-end initiatives, aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, and proactively removing roadblocks for high-quality outcomes in fast-moving environments.

Our commitment to inclusion & belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com.



How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.  

India Annual Pay Range
₹3,050,000—₹4,350,000 INR

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

b3fed030a3851a69.description: Associate Product Manager/ Product Manager Supply Chain Team: Product | Location: Mumbai (Work from Office) About the Team Purplle's Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a lean team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business. About the Role We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who will own our Warehouse Management System (WMS) and internal supply chain tools as the core of the role, while also driving our ERP integration and our data platforms for reporting and data warehousing. You will work at the intersection of product, operations, and data, turning the needs of warehouse stakeholders into reliable, well-built features. This is an individual contributor role that works closely with the data engineering, backend engineering, and analytics teams, as well as operations and business stakeholders, to deliver the roadmap. Key Responsibilities Warehouse Management and Internal Tools Own the product roadmap for the WMS and adjacent internal tools used by warehouse teams. Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA. Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams. Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground, then define structured improvements that scale. ERP Systems Support the integration and data consistency between the WMS and the ERP for sales, inventory, and reconciliation flows. Work with engineering and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure. Help define and validate the impact of ERP-related product changes. Data Platforms, Reporting, and Data Warehousing Lead the reporting and data warehousing layer that gives stakeholders a single, reliable source of truth. Coordinate with the data engineering team on ETL processes and pipelines that feed the warehouse. Build and maintain dashboards and reports covering inventory positions, stock movements, reconciliation health, and system performance. Use data analysis to surface insights and drive data-informed product decisions. Must-Have Skills and Requirements 1+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply-chain technology role. BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory. Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery. Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems. Familiarity with ETL processes and pipelines and how data moves from source systems into a data warehouse. Ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, and to think and work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities. Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, and business teams. High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution. Good-to-Have Skills Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems and ERP systems, and an understanding of how inventory and sales data flow between them. Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase. Experience with SAP or a similar enterprise ERP. Exposure to inventory management, or quick-commerce and dark-store operations. Familiarity with pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow. What You Will Gain End-to-end ownership of the WMS and internal tools that run day-to-day supply chain operations. A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap. Deep exposure to ERP integration and to building the data platform behind business-critical reporting. A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role. .

b395486b886308ce.description: Location: Bangalore & Gurgaon - Hybrid (India) Employment Type: Full-Time About Us We are actively building the next generation of intelligent product ecosystems. Our team doesn't just talk about artificial intelligencewe deploy production-grade LLM pipelines, vector search workflows, and scalable AI infrastructure into real-world applications every single week. If you are passionate about generative AI, low-latency inference, and turning cutting-edge research into reliable software, you will find your home here. The Role We are seeking an innovative AI / Machine Learning Engineer to take charge of our AI infrastructure. You will design, fine-tune, and scale artificial intelligence systems, integrating advanced LLM providers and vector databases into our core product architecture. You will work closely with our core engineering team to ensure our AI features are fast, cost-effective, and deeply integrated. Key Responsibilities RAG Implementation: Architect and scale Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks using vector databases like Qdrant or Pinecone. LLM & Prompt Optimization: Optimize prompt engineering workflows, manage token limits, and evaluate performance across various LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models). Inference Engineering: Build and maintain low-latency, scalable AI inference endpoints using Python and FastAPI. Model Fine-Tuning: Fine-tune open-source models on domain-specific datasets to improve accuracy and business relevance. Pipeline Monitoring: Monitor AI system accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency, implementing caching strategies and fallback mechanisms. What We Are Looking For (Requirements) Experience: 3+ years of professional software/ML engineering experience with a strong focus on production-grade AI systems. Python Mastery: Deep expertise in Python, asynchronous programming, and modern frameworks like FastAPI. Vector & Database Skills: Hands-on experience with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone) and relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL). LLM Ecosystem Knowledge: Proven experience working with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face transformers, and major LLM APIs. System Thinking: Strong grasp of API design, Docker containerization, and cloud deployment (AWS/GCP). What We Offer Competitive Compensation: Top-tier salary bracket paired with performance bonuses and equity options. Cutting-Edge Stack: Freedom to experiment with and deploy the latest AI models and frameworks. Learning & Development: Dedicated stipend for AI conferences, research papers, and advanced certifications. Flexibility &Wellness: Remote-first culture and comprehensive health insurance for you and your family. Our Hiring Process Initial Screening: 30-minute introductory chat with our recruitment team. Technical Assessment: Practical take-home coding challenge or LLM integration task. Deep Dive & System Design: Architecture discussion focused on RAG pipelines, scaling, and past ML projects. Final Chat &Offer: Closing alignment with leadership and official offer rollout. Skills: rag,design,models,llm,learning,api,pipelines,architecture,advanced,machine learning,python,databases,vector .

b394ff9de75f7516.description: We're looking for a Principal Product Manager - HR Platforms & Technology This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office Principal Product Manager | HR Technology & Platforms | Hyderabad Summary Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value. This is a customer-facing AI-native product management role for a hands-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture. The ideal candidate is highly execution-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor About the Team You'll join a growing product team building AI-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows. What Success Looks Like In your first 6 to 12 months, you will: Take end-to-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype. Build strong relationships with customers, FDEs, and engineering partners, establishing a fast, repeatable feedback loop between discovery and prototype iteration. Ship a working AI-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems. Identify meaningful opportunities for your agent(s) to complement others in the portfolio, contributing to how the team thinks about multi-agent value. Establish yourself as a trusted, execution-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight In This Role You Will Lead end-to-end delivery of new AI-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch. Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal-setting, and talent development. Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined. Identify opportunities for new agents to complement existing ones in the portfolio, contributing to a cohesive experience as agents are increasingly deployed together. Build and evolve working prototypes using AI-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms, using prototypes as the new PRD motion so customers, FDEs, and engineering can review, test, and refine solutions directly. Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch, working in tight feedback loops to confirm value and shape deliverable product capabilities. Drive cross-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go-to-market teams to bring validated concepts into production. Turn customer specific outcome agents into re-sellable out-of-the box agents. Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt. Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes. Hands-on experience using AI-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
